chunks: This (for the virtuous); but for the transgressors the evil destination,
ai.seo_question: What is the ultimate destination of the transgressors (al-Taghin) according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Saad, this verse serves as a concluding warning to Pharaoh and his contemporaries, emphasizing that their arrogance (taghut) leads to a wretched abode, contrasting with the mercy granted to the faithful. Shia exegetes often link this 'evil return' to the ultimate fate of those who rejected the Imams and the divine authority, highlighting the spiritual consequence of persistent disobedience.
